name: Midpoint Hub - Gym signup email tables

parameters.subject: ={{ (/^TEST\b/i.test($json.payload.firstName) ? 'TEST - ' : '') + 'Midpoint Gym signup enquiry - ' + $json.session }}
parameters.text:
={{ 'Hi Christine,

A customer would like to join Midpoint Gym.

CONTACT DETAILS
First name: ' + $json.payload.firstName + '
Surname: ' + $json.payload.surname + '
Email address: ' + $json.payload.email + '
Contact number: ' + $json.payload.replyPhone + '
Company / tenant: ' + $json.payload.company + '

SIGNUP DETAILS
Request: Gym signup enquiry
Identity verification: To be completed securely with the Gym team
Reference: ' + $json.session + '

Signup request only. Membership, payment and access setup are completed separately with the Gym team.' }}

parameters.jsCode: const r=$input.first().json; const e=$('Validate Gym signup').first().json; const ok=Array.isArray(r.accepted)&&r.accepted.some(a=>String(a).toLowerCase()==='christine@midpointhub.com')&&!r.error; return [{json:{status:ok?'submitted':'failed',message:ok?'Your signup details have been emailed to Christine. She will help you complete Itensity registration, payment and access setup. This does not activate membership or gym access.':'Your request could not be emailed. Type MENU to try again, or contact christine@midpointhub.com.',session:e.session}}];
